name: Leaf Green
source:
Leaf is a friendly girl from the Kanto region who Red first met encountered in the third-year women's dorm of Relic Hall. She is considered the main heroine, but can also play supporting roles in the story should the player decide to progress that way. Leaf is quick-witted and equally quick to act, making her one of the more reliable characters. However, she is an elusive individual, which prevents most people, even her roommate May, from truly getting to know her.

Leaf was first introduced in Pokémon FireRed and Pokémon LeafGreen versions.
